question: Which Linux companion app direction should OpenClaw pursue for this umbrella: the C/GTK track, the Rust/GTK alternative, a different package shape, or deferral?
rationale: Current main already covers Windows Hub, but Linux remains unshipped and the two active Linux PRs make different language, dependency, packaging, and security tradeoffs that automation cannot choose.

options.title: Sponsor one GTK Linux track
options.body: Pick one Linux PR as the canonical path, require security/packaging proof, and close or redirect the competing implementation once the chosen path is clear.

options.title: Split Linux into narrower milestones
options.body: Keep this umbrella for roadmap context but create smaller Linux issues for packaging, pairing, tray, notifications, and node capabilities before landing app code.

options.title: Defer native Linux app
options.body: Leave Linux on Gateway/CLI/web support for now and close or park the open app PRs until platform-app ownership is ready.

recommendation.title: Sponsor one GTK Linux track
recommendation.body: Pick one Linux PR as the canonical path, require security/packaging proof, and close or redirect the competing implementation once the chosen path is clear.

likelyOwner.reason: He opened the umbrella, provided Linux product-direction comments, and is the strongest current platform-status provenance signal.
